modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Na-aza azụ lava boat clutch mechanic nke edoziri na 1.21.5.

N'oge mbụ ụgbọ mmiri metụtara lava, ụgbọ mmiri ahụ nwetara obere oge nchekwa, ka onye na-egwu nwee ike iru n'elu hitbox ya.

Ugbu a ị nwere ike eme lava clutch dị ka Dream mana na nsogbu ọhụrụ!
